# Staff links for QLearn

**Access key: `forge-ripple-paddock-rosella`**

Paste these links into the QLearn course. Each one already carries the
access key, so staff clicking from QLearn go straight into the page with
nothing to type. List the access key on the QLearn page too, for anyone
who arrives at a page without using these links.
